description: This file defines a console command class 'DBVerifierCommand' that performs various database checks and cleanup operations related to feeds, tokens, mails, blocked users, and project issues within the Goteo project. It also includes commands for running database consistency checks and project failure predictions.

classes.name: DBVerifierCommand
classes.description: A console command class for performing database verification and cleanup operations, including cleaning old feeds, tokens, mails, blocked users, and running project-specific checks.

methods.name: configure
methods.description: Sets up the command name, description, arguments, options, and help text.

methods.name: execute
methods.description: Executes the database verification tasks based on input options and arguments, performing cleanup and checks as needed.
